snippet.title: Stardream - Gameplay Overview | AG French Direct 2026
snippet.description:
The investigation game Stardream reveals its secrets in a new developer diary. Gaëthan Bercert, art director, and Théo Vart, game director, tell us more about the title’s influences and gameplay mechanics. Stardream will be released on PC. (↓)
